messages:
sarah_finance: Hey team — our partner month-end usage for AtlasCloud doesn't line up with the GCP marketplace export. Invoice total is ~18% higher than the marketplace usage report. Can someone take a look before we close the month? @aj_ops FYI.

aj_ops: On it. Do you have an example invoice line or the partner's subscription IDs?

sarah_finance: Attached the invoice snippet and the partner portal CSV I downloaded: https://files.redwood/finance/atlascloud_feb_invoice.csv. Root cause might be mid-month seat moves they mentioned earlier.

lina_recon: I pulled the partner portal reconciliation dump as well. Quick look shows AtlasCloud has two subscriptions (sub-A / sub-B). The GCP report only lists sub-A. Possible tag/sku mismatch on sub-B so it didn't join.

kevin_sales: AtlasCloud told us they consolidated seats into a new subscription on 2024-02-12 — they may have left usage under the old sub for a few days. I've looped in their AM.

gcp_billing_bot: GCP export ready: gcp-billing-2024-02-01_to_2024-02-28.csv (s3://redwood-billing/exports/gcp/2024-02/).

aj_ops: Hmm looks like our mapping table expects partner_sku exactly 'rdw_channel_v1' but the invoice and GCP use 'rdw-channel-v1' (dash vs underscore). When join is exact we drop the rows. Running quick normalize: ```awk -F"," '{gsub("_","-",$3); print}' mapping.csv > mapping_norm.csv``` then re-join.

lina_recon: Nice catch — that would explain the missing lines. I'll run the reconciliation with normalized SKUs and post the diff shortly.

sarah_finance: If normalization accounts for the delta, we will likely need a retro credit. Estimated variance ~ $9,120. @finance-approvals please note pending evidence.

kevin_sales: :thumbsup: I'll get partner confirmation from AtlasCloud and post once they ack.

finance-approvals: Noted. For credits > $5k we need partner acknowledgment + CSV diff + AR ticket. Please attach when ready.

lina_recon: Uploaded diffs and evidence: https://files.redwood/finance/reconciliations/atlascloud_feb_diff.csv. Summary: 1,842 unallocated seat-minutes re-attributed to sub-B => $9,245. Query used: `SELECT sku, subscription_id, SUM(minutes) FROM partner_usage WHERE month='2024-02' GROUP BY 1,2;` Full diffs in the CSV. @sarah_finance @kevin_sales

sarah_finance: Thanks Lina — creating AR ticket now (AR-2024-0421) and attaching the diff + partner confirmation. Will route to billing for credit approval once we have partner sign-off.

kevin_sales: Partner confirmed consolidation and accepts the adjustment. Moving to approve on our end once AR ticket is attached to the invoice.

aj_ops: Marking mapping rule change as a patch to avoid future underscore/dash mismatches. I'll open infra task (INF-1257) to add SKU normalization in ETL and add a unit test.

sarah_finance: Great — thanks everyone. We'll close when AR-2024-0421 shows approved status.
